workshop.title: AuTOMATO Workshop
workshop.subtitle: New world effect · will be created in the folder “{folder}”
workshop.name: Effect name

expiryLong.turn-start: at the start of the turn
expiryLong.turn-end: at the end of the turn

workshop.noBlocks: The effect does nothing yet. Pick a property below, for example an AC bonus.
workshop.dropHint: Or drag a condition or effect from a compendium onto the window.
workshop.dropBad: You can drop a condition or effect here.
workshop.auraNote: Who the aura affects is set up in the pf2e effect sheet.
workshop.descEmpty: The description appears once you add properties.
workshop.footHint: Fine tuning — in the regular pf2e effect sheet.

err.name: Enter an effect name.
err.level: Level must be a whole number from 0.
err.duration: Duration must be a whole number above zero (or choose “Unlimited”).
err.value: the value must be a number above zero.
err.except: exceptions are pf2e keys in Latin letters, comma-separated.
err.dice: the number of dice must be a whole number above zero.
err.slug: the slug is Latin letters, digits and hyphens (or leave it empty).
err.radius: the radius must be a multiple of 5 from 5 to 240.
err.light: set bright or dim light (numbers of at least zero).
err.rawKey: expected an object with a key field (or an array of those).
err.exceptUnknown: pf2e does not know the type “{key}”.
err.lightDim: dim light cannot be smaller than bright light.

au.chWhenHint: pf2e predicate: the challenge is made only for matching targets. Roll options separated by commas (all must hold) or JSON.

mod.durHint: A custom effect needs a duration: a number or a die (1d4).
mod.slugNote: The target gets an effect named “Effect: [item]” with slug af-[item slug]; the “remove effect” and “extend effect” steps find it by that slug.

chs.label: Label
chs.hint: The code is a latin slug (fire); conditions of later steps check it as choice:fire. An option condition is a pf2e predicate on the author.

ref.label: Extras

why.needTarget: Only when the step applies to the target.
why.needCarrier: Needs a condition or effect step: this removes what the step created.
why.vsRepeat: Cannot be combined with a repeat save.
why.noReduce: Cannot be combined with the condition policy “reduce by value”.
why.noBadge: Cannot be combined with a badge (+1 / −1).
why.noOwn: Cannot be combined with an effect made of properties.
why.empty: No value set: the pill does nothing.

ref.escHint: The victim removes what this step created with a check. An empty DC uses the DC of the use. “Author's DC”: spell is the author's spell DC, or a skill name.

repOn.turn-start: at the start of the target's turn
repOn.turn-end: at the end of the target's turn

ref.repHintIn: The save and DC come from the rule's challenge.
ref.repHintOut: Outside a challenge the save and DC are required.
ref.unlessHint: The step is skipped if the recipient already has this effect (for example, an immunity after the action).
ref.choiceHint: Preselects the value in the effect's choice prompt (ChoiceSet), for example a skill name.

au.denied: This item type has no automation rule.
au.switch: The rule of “{name}” has unsaved changes. Discard them and switch?

when.onUse: On use · run by the GM
when.onAttacked: When the owner is attacked: {value} {type} AC

au.areaSpell: Saved to the spell's Area field (system.area): {shape}, {size} ft. The area is not a rule field.
au.areaDesc: This item has no Area field: {tag} is added to the description on save (or with the button). The area is not a rule field.

roll.checkSelf: Author: {stat}, the system sets the DC

au.unstack: Decrease the badge by 1 (at the minimum the effect is removed)
au.extendCastPlate: Extend this casting's effects by {rounds} rd.
au.stepWhenHint: pf2e roll options separated by commas, all must hold; for anything more, a JSON predicate. If not met, the step is skipped
au.immAny: To every creature of this kind, not only this author
au.hintPossibleTip: {name}: click to add this condition to this degree
au.hintTimedTip: {name}: pf2e cannot express this as a step — describe it manually or with a macro
au.dragHint: or drag a condition, effect or macro from a compendium
au.effDurHint: A number or a die (1d4); empty — the effect's own duration.

movePlate.pushPoint: push {distance} ft from the area centre
movePlate.pullPoint: pull up to {distance} ft to the area centre
movePlate.choose: move {distance} ft in a chosen direction

affl.name: Name
affl.bad: The affliction definition is unreadable (broken JSON). Change the step kind and create it again.
affl.dcTip: Empty: the DC comes from the challenge or the item use.
affl.virulentTip: A success lowers the stage only after two successes in a row; a critical success lowers it by 1.
affl.stageTip: The stage this step starts the affliction at. The definition is shared by all steps, the stage is the step's own.
affl.noteTip: What the module does not automate (cannot be removed, death, transformation). Shown on the effect and the first stage card; who sees it is a world setting.
affl.textTip: What is not automated: shown on the affliction card.
affl.splitTip: Give this step its own independent copy of the definition: edits stop going to the other steps.
affl.shared: The definition is shared by the steps: {steps}. Editing it here changes all of them; only the starting stage is per step.

coat.durTip: Without a duration the poison stays on the weapon until spent. Needed e.g. for Envenom (until the end of the next turn).
coat.degrees: What the poison does to the target
coat.back: Back to the weapon poison step

au.macrosNone: None. A macro can hook any phase: use, degree, zone entry.
au.macrosHint: Drag a macro here from the hotbar or the Macros directory.
au.dropBad: Drop a condition, effect or macro here.
au.dropColumn: Drop it on a degree column or the “At once” list.

story.check: The author rolls {stat} against {vs} of each target; the outcome depends on the author's degree.
story.checkSelf: The author rolls {stat} as the action; the system sets the DC and the outcome depends on the degree.
story.onAttacked: When the owner is attacked, a reaction hint offers {value} {type} AC.

applyMode.button: Conditions are applied by the GM's button in chat (world setting).
applyMode.off: Automatic application is off (world setting): the rule only describes.

au.probeBlocked: Fix the rule errors (see the footer) to see the odds.
au.probeNone: No roll: nothing to calculate, the steps apply at once.
au.probeNoTokens: Select or target tokens to see the odds.
au.allFound: All conditions and links were found.
au.notInItem: The rule is not stored in the item
au.probeDcHint: The DC cannot be determined (no owner). Only for the test, not saved in the rule.
au.areaUnparsed: The description has an @Template tag we cannot parse; it is left untouched. The area is not a rule field.
au.closeAsk: The rule of “{name}” has unsaved changes. Close and discard them?
au.probeOnlyUse: The test run is only for the “On use” event.

keep.basic: basic save: x0 / x1/2 / x1 / x2 by degree
keep.repeat: repeat save on the target's turn

item.title: New item
item.headNew: {type} · will be created in the folder “{folder}”
item.headCopy: Copy of “{name}” · becomes a new item

typeHint.consumable: Potion, elixir, scroll — used up when activated
typeHint.equipment: Passive properties while worn or invested
typeHint.weapon: Damage die and type, group; extra properties
typeHint.action: An ability with an effect on yourself
typeHint.feat: Passive or action with an effect on yourself

item.copyLabel: Or copy a base from a compendium
item.searchHint: Type at least two letters of the name.
item.baseIs: Base: “{name}” (a copy — a new item, not linked to the original)
item.copyHint: The copy keeps the other pf2e fields — change only what differs. The original and its automation rules are untouched.
item.name: Item name
item.linkNote: A link to the chosen effect is appended to the description automatically — pf2e shows it in chat.
item.dropEffect: Or drag an effect from a compendium or the world onto this frame.
item.passiveNote: A passive ability cannot have an effect on self — pf2e clears it. Pick another type.
item.blocksNote: Properties while the item is worn — the same properties as in Effect mode; written straight into the item.

does.consumable: The automation rule applies the chosen effect when the consumable is used — to the user or to the selected target.
does.equipment: Rule Elements work while the item is worn (for an item with the Invested trait — while invested too): no extra conditions needed, pf2e requires this itself.
does.weapon: The properties affect this weapon while it is held (or worn): “all Strikes” is narrowed to the weapon itself.
does.action: The effect is written into pf2e’s native “effect on self” field: the system draws the card button itself.
does.feat: The effect is written into pf2e’s native “effect on self” field: the system draws the card button itself.

item.autoNone: No rule yet: pick an effect on the “What it does” step.
item.autoOff: Auto-build is off — no rule will be written; the effect is applied by hand from the description.

autoNote.rules: This type needs no automation rule: the properties are written into the item and work through pf2e.
autoNote.ability: No automation rule is built for this type: the effect on self is a native pf2e field. Fine-tune in the pipeline after creating.

item.pipeAfter: Available after the item is created.

plan.effect: Effect “{name}” — already exists, will be linked to the item
plan.rule: Automation rule in the item flag
plan.actor: A copy will be given to the actor “{name}”

dest.actor: World and give to the selected ({name})
dest.actorNone: World and give to the selected (no token)

item.footHint: Steps can be done in any order.
item.returnHint: Create the effect — and you return to the item with the effect filled in.
item.descEmpty: The description appears once you write it.

note.effectSelf: Effect: “{name}” is applied to the user.
note.effectTarget: Effect: “{name}” is applied to the selected target.

item.dropBad: Drop an effect or a condition here.
item.stale: The item is already created: further changes will not reach it.
item.closeAsk: The item draft has not been created. Close and discard it?
item.dropNo: An effect can be set on a consumable or a non-passive action/feat.

err.name: Enter the item name.
err.level: Level is a whole number from 0 to 30.
err.levelFeat: Feat level is a whole number from 1 to 30.
err.price: Price is a number not less than zero.
err.uses: Charges is a whole number above zero.
err.dice: Number of damage dice is a whole number above zero.
err.range: Range increment is a whole number from 5 ft.
err.rule: The automation rule could not be built: {error}
err.rawGrant: A GrantItem in an item works only with inMemoryOnly:true and a pf2e condition UUID (Compendium.….conditionitems.Item.…).
err.actorType: Actor “{name}” does not accept items of type “{type}” — choose “World only”.
err.condEffect: equipment and weapons only support pf2e conditions, not effects — pick a condition.
err.noActor: Select an actor’s token or choose “World only”.
